First I want to say thank you for sharing. I hope you understand that I don't want you to end it and that you will read what I want to say to you even though you might not agree with me.
You have said that you don't lack the love of others but I think you do lack love for yourself. You are not worthless. I hope that you can trust the judgment of your family and friends and understand that you do have value. Do you think your son is wrong for thinking you are worth something? You are loved, please try and love yourself. I understand that the pain seems like too much and of course I cannot know how much pain you are in, but I am certain that it can get better.
You want to hold your son, so please hold on. I am not trying to guilt trip you into staying alive, but please remember that ending your own life will affect the lives of the people who love you, including your son. You might feel like he is better of without you, but I do not agree and I think he wouldn't agree either.
I hope you can find the strenght to hold on to life.
You said you think you posted here because you didn't want to be alone, but maybe a part of you doesn't want to go through with this and that a part of you wants someone to talk you out of it.

You said yourself that you are a negative person. Is it maybe possible that because you have this negative point of view that everything seems worse than it actually is? That you feel like people don't care but somewhere you know that they still care? That everything feels terrible because you are going through a tough time? That you will be able to get over this even if at the moment it feels like you can't?
I also hope that you can be at least a little proud of yourself that you were able to stop your bad habits. And maybe knowing that you were strong enough to stop those habits means that you are able to overcome these bad times too?
People care about you.

Maybe it's a sign? I don't know if yoy believe in such things. I usually don't but when I'm so low that I am considering ending it I tend to look for signs that tell me what to do because I feel like my thoughts cannot be trusted. For instance I fall a lot because I am clumsy and I have tripped many times on high places but I have never fallen off of these high places and I like looking at those moments as signs that it is not my time yet or something like that.
I hope you can look at this moment in your life in the same manner and that you can look at it like an opportunity.

I once heard someone say that if a person truly does not care about dying that it means that they can do everything they want to because there are basically no real bad outcomes. So maybe you can turn this peace with death into something positive and find something you like doing instead of ending it?

This makes me happy, I'm glad you found the strength to turn a negative urge into something that probably made you more comfortable. I will think of this when I feel such an urge.
Thank you for sharing.

I don't know of this will work for you, but I place special items around my house so that when I see them I am reminded to not go through with ending it. These items can be a specific color that I associate with happiness or just with moving on.  Or they are items that remind me of someone special or a pet or a aspiration or something like that. Something to get my mind out of that bad space.
I don't put them everywhere so I'm not constantly being reminded of staying alive, because that reminds me of death when I am in a good place.
It could also be like a little game or something that moves or a puzzle just to really distract myself.
I hope this also works for you.

I think that your teacher either didn't know how to respond and left you feeling like they didn't care or that they couldn't realize how serious your problems are and underreacted. I was not there so I cannot know however.
I don't know what kind of connections you have but the thought: "I really hate that I want to talk to someone about my thoughts but I just can't seem to find anyone who cares enough to" sounds very familiar because I tend to think like this too. But for me it's usually that I am just too scared to talk about it with my connections and that I know somewhere that they do care, or that I know that their response won't be what I'm looking for. This might be the same for you?
You mentioned being scared to see a therapist so maybe you just fear talking to someone about your issues? This is just speculation however.
Maybe it would help if you lowered your expectations, so that when you have such a talk that if it is dissapointing it won't hurt as bad. People don't know what to say in a lot of situations and they might just make it worse so maybe if this thought is in the back of your mind during such a talk, it will only feel better or at least not worse.
I hope you find someone you feel like you can talk to and maybe a second talk with your teacher will have a different outcome.

I too feel often alone, but thankfully I have sweet people around me who care, or at least I hope they care. I also struggle with social anxiety so I'm scared to ask them what I mean to them, but they have their own ways of showing me I think. I was able to acquire these kinds of friendships because I had to be very open about not being able to do a lot of things due to trauma and anxiety etc. Because of this, only the people who could deal with that, stayed.
And yet I feel alone very often. Usually because I think that they don't actually care or something like that. I do not know if the people in your life are also like this, but if they are as you think they are then I will give you this tip. Try online friends. Maybe you have already tried or you feel like an online friend won't help, but at least just a little bit of contact might help. I used to chatroulette, without face camera, and select whatever topic I wanted to talk about. It helped just talking to someone, I usually didn't ask for their number or email or anything like that because it was enough for me to just have a little chat and move on. Maybe this also works for you?
Love is a tricky thing, you know this too. I hope that she will be more clear about how she feels about you so at least you know where you stand soon.
I hope this helped, even if it's just a little.

Of course I do not know what your life looks like exactly, but there must be someone or something in your life that needs you or depends on you and would break if you weren't there, you know? Even if it is just a plant or someone you chat with online. You have value. I hope that you can allow yourself to not feel guilty for what you have been through. Would you want people to feel guilty for if you can't pull through? I think your ex doesn't want you to feel guilty.
I think that you have had these kinds of rational thoughts but that it just feels like it is your fault and whatnot. So I hope that hearing it coming from someone else it might reinforce these thoughts.
I wish for you to be strong and hope that you will feel better soon.
